key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:09B4
name: format_word_as_digit_chars
description: Turns a 16-bit value into four characters, one for each nibble from the top, using the digits 0-9 or the letters A-F. It returns the last character it produced.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:09E6
name: mark_heaviest_records_within_budget
description: Scans the twenty-byte record table for type-three records whose top flag bit matches the argument, picking the one with the largest byte at offset six each time. Each pick becomes type four with the flag bit set, and its amount at offset sixteen is subtracted from a running budget. Once the budget goes negative or no candidate remains, it calls itself.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0A48
name: mark_records_within_budget
description: Marks the record it is given as type four with the flag bit and subtracts its amount at offset sixteen from a running value. It stops once that value goes negative; otherwise it picks the next matching type-three record, largest weight first, and repeats. It calls itself at the end.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0A68
name: process_type4_records_adjust_counters
description: Walks the record table until the end marker. For each record of type four it calls a helper to process it, then subtracts the helper's returned value from one of two global counters, chosen by the record's top flag bit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AA6
name: process_type4_records_from_pointer
description: Subtracts a given value from one global counter, then walks the record table from a starting record, handing each type-four record to a helper. Unflagged records subtract the helper's result from a second counter, while a flagged record ends the pass and restarts the first subtraction.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AB4
name: return_without_effect
description: Only returns, so it changes no memory or registers. It is a stub: the recovered code never fills in this call target.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0ABA
name: move_block_and_adjust_pointers
description: Copies a block of words from a source address to a destination address, in blocks of 32768 words. Afterwards it shifts the pointer at offset two of each matching record that lies beyond the destination by the distance moved.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0ADC
name: copy_words_then_adjust_pointers
description: Copies a counted run of words from a source to a destination, then subtracts a passed-in distance from the offset-two pointer of every record beyond a threshold whose top flag bit matches the argument.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AE6
name: copy_word_blocks_adjust_pointers
description: Copies words from a source to a destination in fixed blocks of 32768 words, repeated for a count held in a register. Then it subtracts a passed-in distance from the offset-two pointer of each record beyond a threshold whose flag bit matches.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0B1C
name: return_without_effect
description: Only returns, so it changes no memory or registers. It is a stub: the recovered code never fills in this call target.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0B22
name: dispatch_timed_codes_to_records
description: Loops indefinitely over a pass that clears a 128-entry word array and 32 longs in the global area, then compares the current code against nine fixed values. On a match it marks up to four table records as active and stores values into working globals. The routine uses the raster position register (VHPOSR).

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0C9E
name: clear_out_of_range_records
description: Walks the twenty-byte record table for the stored record count, zeroing the first byte of each record whose second byte lies outside three to six. It then copies two backup globals back into their working counterparts.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0CE4
name: clear_all_records_restore_values
description: Zeroes the first byte of every twenty-byte record for the stored record count. It then copies two backup globals back into their working counterparts.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0D1A
name: count_table_entries_to_sentinel
description: Counts twenty-byte table entries until one has a first word of minus one, then stores the count of entries before that sentinel, minus one, in a global.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:37B8
name: draw_line_with_blitter
description: Sets up the blitter in line mode for a line between two screen points on a 40-byte-per-row bitmap. It swaps the endpoints when a flag is set, computes the major and minor deltas and octant bits, writes the control and modulo registers, and uses a scratch area when an endpoint lies on the screen boundary.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:38D2
name: clip_line_then_draw
description: Computes an outcode for each endpoint of a line and returns without drawing when both endpoints lie outside the same screen edge. Otherwise it clips the segment against the screen bounds, stores the clipped endpoints in globals, and passes them to a drawing helper.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3A24
name: return_without_effect
description: Only returns, so it changes no memory or registers. It is a stub: the recovered code never fills in this call target.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3A50
name: subdivide_segment_at_midpoint
description: Repeatedly halves a segment at its midpoint, passing each piece to a helper. It stops when the midpoint equals either endpoint, when a mask test on a stored flag fails, or when a flag already marks the segment as done.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3AE6
name: fill_polygon_scanline_spans
description: Scales and offsets each byte-coded vertex, then walks consecutive vertex pairs through a helper, recording the left and right crossing x positions for each scanline in a buffer. When the walk ends, it passes each recorded span pair to a helper until a sentinel value is reached.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3C00
name: blit_polygon_span_fill
description: Walks the vertex list the way the span builder does, scaling and offsetting each vertex and recording scanline crossings, then passes each span pair on for drawing. The listed blitter registers suggest the spans are drawn by the blitter, though those writes sit in called routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3F7C
name: fill_draw_record_then_wait
description: Writes its arguments into a draw record at offset 64 of a given base pointer, together with fixed values, then waits until the blitter is idle.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3FBA
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Polls the blitter busy bit in the DMA status register until the blitter is idle, then returns.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3FCA
name: decode_joystick_direction_flags
description: Reads a stored input word holding joystick movement and fire-button bits, and derives two direction values and a button flag from it. An XOR-shift of the movement bits gives the second direction, and the results are written into a state record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4068
name: copy_four_longwords_to_globals
description: Calls a helper first, then copies four 32-bit values from the record it points to into four global variables.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4084
name: scale_small_value_by_sixteen
description: Returns the input word unchanged when it is above three; otherwise it returns the word multiplied by sixteen.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:40B8
name: return_without_effect
description: Only returns, so it changes no memory or registers. It is a stub with no effect.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:40EC
name: draw_clipped_shifted_object
description: Draws one object from the object table after checking that it lies within the screen horizontally and vertically. It clips the top and bottom rows, shifts each row horizontally by the low bits of the x position, and calls a routine from a dispatch table, chosen by the low nibble of a register, for each row word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:42D0
name: mask_four_word_targets
description: ANDs four 16-bit words, each reached through its own pointer, with a mask value, clearing every bit not set in the mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:42DA
name: mask_three_words_return_code
description: ANDs three 16-bit words, each reached through a pointer, with a mask value. It then returns the input byte with a fixed set of bits ORed in.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4484
name: apply_mask_bits_to_planes
description: Walks up to four stored bitplane pointers. For each mask bit that is set it ORs the inverted word into the plane word at a fixed offset, and for each clear bit it ANDs the word into the plane.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45BC
name: allocate_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the system memory allocation routine through the exec library vector, and returns minus one when it gives back a null pointer.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45DA
name: free_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the system memory-free routine through the exec library vector, then returns minus one when the call's result is zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45FA
name: queue_row_draw_commands
description: Writes draw-command records for a span of screen rows, each holding fixed mode and mask words and offsets derived from the vertical position. A vertical value at the edge of the normal range takes a separate path with its own offsets, and the loop repeats until the helper returns zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4716
name: apply_bit_mask_four_words
description: Checks four bits of a mask value in turn. For each bit it stores an all-ones or all-zero word into a record field and calls a helper, then finishes by calling another helper.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:477C
name: switch_display_mode_copper
description: Changes the display for a mode code: a sentinel code swaps two sets of four longs, while other codes copy new values. It then waits for a raster position and builds a copper list of bitplane pointer and colour entries, and restarts the copper.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4950
name: dispatch_keyboard_scancode
description: Decodes the keyboard serial byte into a key code by rotating its bits, then maps certain keys to display window and playfield register settings, a timed event code, or stored flags. Unrecognised codes return without action.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:49A4
name: set_display_window_registers
description: Writes fixed display window, fetch and playfield control values for one display mode, zeroes the modulo registers, and clears a stored flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A22
name: set_display_window_zeroing_modulo
description: Writes fixed display window, fetch and playfield control values with a different playfield control word, zeroes the modulo registers, and clears a stored flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A46
name: clear_playfield_control_words
description: Clears the playfield control and modulo words in a register block, relative to a base pointer, and clears a stored flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A82
name: set_playfield_modulo_forty
description: Clears two playfield control words and sets the two playfield modulo words to 40, the row length used by the other blitter routines, then sets a stored flag to one.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4AF2
name: reset_input_state_from_table
description: Sets one stored word to all ones, copies the low byte of a table entry into another stored word, and clears a third stored word. The keyboard serial register listed among the facts is not read in this code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4B62
name: wait_for_raster_line
description: Polls the vertical position register until the raster reaches a fixed line, then returns its input value unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4B84
name: write_dma_control_register
description: Writes the DMA control register, where a set top bit enables the channels named in the write, and calls one other routine. The decompiler timed out, so the exact channels and call sequence are not recovered from the code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4C50
name: lookup_record_when_code_matches
description: If its first argument is zero, it stores the second argument into a global, or calls a helper when that is zero. Otherwise it looks up a record through a helper and, when the record's code field equals 257, stores the record's pointer and value into globals; a mismatch calls a further helper and returns.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4CBC
name: open_ciaa_and_fill_table
description: Fills a fifteen-entry table with longwords taken from matching records, zeroing entries that do not match. On first use it opens the ciaa resource through the exec library and returns a flag for whether that call succeeded.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D4C
name: close_ciaa_resource_if_open
description: If the ciaa resource is marked open, calls the exec library's close routine through its vector and clears the open flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D96
name: write_ciaa_control_register
description: Writes a fixed control value of 129 to the CIA-A control register, then writes a second value read from a stored location into it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D9E
name: copy_stored_value_to_global
description: Copies a stored value into a global variable. The timer registers listed among the facts are not referenced in the code shown, which only performs this copy.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DB6
name: clear_table_entry_fields
description: Walks a fifteen-entry pointer table and zeroes the longword at offset eight of each non-null record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DCE
name: silence_audio_channels
description: Sets the volume register of each of the four audio channels to zero, then clears two stored values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DF2
name: silence_audio_channels_set_flag
description: Sets the volume register of each of the four audio channels to zero, then sets a stored value to fifteen.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E10
name: call_helper_return_zero
description: Calls one other routine and returns zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E18
name: advance_audio_channel_counter
description: Increments a stored counter. Until it reaches six, it calls a helper once for each of the four audio channel register blocks, counting the channel index down; at six it resets the counter and calls another helper.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E3C
name: run_routine_per_audio_channel
description: Calls a helper once for each of the four audio channel register blocks, counting the channel index down from three, then returns the stack argument unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E70
name: update_channel_state_or_dispatch
description: If a channel's step value is nonzero, adds it to the channel's level and clamps the result between two limits, storing it in the record. If the step is zero, it decodes the event byte's type: type one calls through a dispatch table, while types seven and eight set a sign and look up a limit in a table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E92
name: step_and_clamp_channel_value
description: Adds a step value to a stored word, takes the larger of that result and a lower limit stored at offset four, and stores the result in a record field and back in the word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EA6
name: decode_channel_event_type
description: Decodes the type nibble of an event byte. Type one calls an entry from a dispatch table, while types seven and eight set a sign and look up a value in a table of pairs keyed by the event value; other types return without action.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EC4
name: set_event_fields_from_table
description: Stores event fields into a record, with a level from the low nibble of a byte, then searches a table of words for the event's value until a sentinel. When found it stores the matching entry, offset by the high nibble, and otherwise stores the event value itself.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EFE
name: copy_word_with_signed_offset
description: Computes a signed word offset from an input value, with the sign chosen by a flag, and copies a word from a source address offset by that amount to offset four of a record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F10
name: store_word_into_record_field
description: Stores the input word into offset four of the record pointed to by a register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F16
name: store_signed_event_fields
description: Stores an event word into a record, along with a level taken from the low nibble of a byte that is negated. It then searches a table of words for the event's value and stores the matching entry, offset by the high nibble, or the event value itself when nothing matches.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F1A
name: dispatch_via_counter_table
description: Calls one entry of a dispatch table, selected by a stored counter minus one. The jump table address could not be recovered, so the target routine is not named.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F52
name: copy_matching_table_entry
description: Searches a table of words for the value stored at offset sixteen of a record, then copies the entry at the input index from that position into offset six of the record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F6C
name: copy_high_nibble_table_entry
description: Searches the same table for the record's value at offset sixteen, then copies the entry offset by the high nibble of a byte in the record into offset six of the record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F76
name: copy_low_nibble_table_entry
description: Searches the same table for the record's value at offset sixteen, then copies the entry offset by the low nibble of a byte in the record into offset six of the record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F82
name: copy_word_between_records
description: Copies the word at offset sixteen of one record into offset six of another record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F8C
name: start_audio_dma_channels
description: Clears a channel-enable word, runs a helper for each of the four audio channels, then writes the enable word with its top bit set to the DMA control register. After a short delay it loads the audio location and length registers for each active channel from the channel table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5078
name: advance_sound_channel_sequence
description: Reads the next step of a channel's sequence, loading a sample pointer, a table value and a volume when the step is a note. Sentinel values store a value into a status word or clear the channel, and otherwise the volume and step are handed on to the step finisher.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:50E8
name: finish_channel_sequence_step
description: Applies the volume envelope for the channel's current step, raising the volume for type five and lowering it for type six. It then handles sentinel values and stores the step's values into the channel record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5124
name: apply_volume_and_store_step
description: Adds an offset to a channel's volume, clamps the result to 64, and stores it in the record. It then handles sentinel values as the sequence step does, otherwise storing the step's sample pointer, length and volume into the record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5156
name: store_channel_step_record
description: If the step word is nonzero, it clears a field, copies the step's values into the channel record, waits a short delay, and ORs the channel's flag into a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5184
name: copy_channel_sample_fields
description: Copies a longword and two words from a channel record into the output block, and ORs the record's flag word into a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5344
name: fill_bitplanes_by_mask
description: For each of four bitplanes, fills a block of 8000 longwords with all ones or all zeros, chosen by one bit of an input mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5376
name: lock_df0_volume_as_current
description: Releases any earlier DOS lock, waits for a keyboard serial code, pauses briefly, then locks the DF0: volume and makes it the current directory. If the lock fails, it closes the lock handle.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5472
name: wait_for_disk_status_clear
description: Polls the disk-status bit in the CIA port register until it clears, then calls one other routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:54B6
name: read_file_chunk_with_locks
description: Opens and seeks within a disk file to read a chunk, keeping the file handle cached between calls and closing it when a different file is requested. It takes the system's multitasking and blitter locks around the access.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55B0
name: own_blitter_return_minus_one
description: Calls two library vectors through the exec and graphics bases, then returns minus one unless an ownership flag set in between is true. In that case it calls another routine when two arguments differ.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55C0
name: fill_color_register_delay
description: Writes a colour value to the background colour register in a nested countdown loop, so the repeated writes form a timed colour pulse.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55E2
name: delay_then_zero_color_register
description: Runs a long countdown loop, then writes zero 4096 times to one fixed location. The facts list the background colour register as touched by this routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:560C
name: allocate_buffers_open_libs
description: Opens the DOS and graphics libraries, reads the free memory size, and lays out sixteen buffers spaced 8000 bytes apart, storing their pointers in globals. It then derives further offsets from the allocations it obtains.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:57E6
name: toggle_dma_channel_bits
description: Writes a DMA control value that clears one group of channel bits, then writes a second value that sets another group together with the enable bit. Two other routines are called around the writes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5808
name: register_interrupt_server_node
description: Allocates an interrupt node through a helper, fills in its data pointer, a priority of 100, a type code of two and a handler routine, then registers the node with the exec library. The handler only adds one to a counter and clears a register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:585E
name: forbid_and_own_blitter
description: Disables multitasking through the exec library and claims the blitter through the graphics library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5874
name: permit_and_disown_blitter
description: Releases the blitter through the graphics library and re-enables multitasking through the exec library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:588A
name: start_copper_list_from_struct
description: Loads the copper list pointer from a field of a stored structure, clears the copper restart register, and enables copper DMA by writing the set bit to the DMA control register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:58A8
name: call_four_routines_return_zero
description: Calls four other routines in sequence and returns zero.

description: Boot block entry point. It sets two memory-load descriptors, calls a library routine through its vector, then clears the sprite position registers. It writes DMA control values and copies a block of code from the boot block to a fixed address.
